3033 Wilson Boulevard 
Suite 700 
Arlington, VA 22201 
703.243.9423 
www.consovoymccarthy.com	

July 18, 2018 

Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re: 

Sturgeon v. Frost, No. 17-949 

Dear Mr. Harris, 

I represent the Petitioner in the above-captioned case, in which certiorari 
was granted on June 18, 2018. Petitioner and Respondents respectfully request a 
short extension of the schedule for merits briefing. We have spoken to Rachel 
Kovner in the Office of the Solicitor General, counsel for Respondents, who 
consents to this request. 

Under the current schedule, Petitioner’s merits brief is due on August 2nd 

and Respondents’ brief is due on September 4th. The parties propose that 
Petitioner’s brief be due on August 7th and Respondents’ brief be due on 
September 11th. We have spoken to Ms. Denise McNerney in your office, who 
stated that this schedule is acceptable to the Clerk’s Office. 

Respectfully submitted, 

s/ William S. Consovoy 
will@consovoymccarthy.com 

Counsel for Petitioner
